name: @password2d/angular
description: Angular bindings for the 2D Password engine
author: Password2D Team

scripts.prepack: npm run build:core && npm run build && rm -rf node_modules/@password2d/core && mkdir -p node_modules/@password2d/core && cp -r ../core/dist node_modules/@password2d/core && echo '{"name": "@password2d/core", "version": "1.0.0", "main": "dist/index.js"}' > node_modules/@password2d/core/package.json
